messages:
Alex H: Morning async — quick updates for launch prep. TL;DR: payload slim, spec questions, CRs pending.
What I did: merged embed-cache fix, validated canary metric.
Blockers: awaiting UX signoff on modal copy and the API schema PR.
Today: pair with Maria on canary, triage CRs, finish rollout doc. @Maria P @Sofia R

Maria P: Thanks — quick note: UX pinged back, they want a short copy tweak, not a redesign. See Figma link and I'll drop suggested wording in the spec doc. I'll take the API schema PR review after breakfast.

Devon L: FYI left comments on PR #4321 — main concern is the schema change could break client deserialization for older SDKs. Recommend a backwards-compatible mapping layer. Happy to pair around 1pm.

Sofia R: I'll do UX signoff once the wording's in spec. Also flag: dashboard missing an embed-cache latency panel — @Evan (oncall) can you add one so we can watch p50/p95?

Evan (oncall): On it, adding a panel now. I'm watching the canary for 30m after merge; if p95 spikes >300ms I'll trigger rollback.

Alex H: Quick prioritization call — proposal: ship modal copy + embed-cache fix first, hold API schema change to next sprint unless we can make it opt-in behind a feature flag. Opinions?

Maria P: Agree with opt-in flag approach. I'll update the spec with a feature-flag section and suggested flag names.

Devon L: Sounds good. I'll implement the flag in the PR and add unit/integration tests. ETA EOD.

Sofia R: Small UX quibble: modal header feels long on mobile. I'll post two shorter variants in the spec for A/B. :thinking_face:

Alex H: :thumbsup: A/B is low risk — include variant IDs so we can toggle in canary.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: Canary deploy started for commit abc123. Status: queued -> in-progress.

Evan (oncall): Seeing a few 429s around 10:12 but within tolerance. Watching error budget.

Alex H: If anyone's blocked on reviews, drop a :thumbsup: here and I'll reassign reviewers. Maria — can you update the rollout doc with the flag details by noon so QA has clear steps?

Maria P: Will do, updating now.

Devon L: :thumbsup:

Sofia R: I'll post the two copy variants in the spec by 11:15 and ping here for signoff.

Alex H: Thanks team. Quick reminder: ship checklist lives at repo /docs/launch-checklist.md — mark items 'must' vs 'nice-to-have' and I'll consolidate before EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder posted: daily async standup thread — add any new blockers below.
